usage.callShape: GET https://x402.dexter.cash/onchain/activity (no body, no query params per registry spec)
usage.outputShape: Expected token/wallet trade summary (volumes, top counterparties, sample trades) but server returned error: body.ok=false, body.error="internal_error"
quirks: Endpoint took payment ($0.05 USDC on Base) then returned HTTP 500 with {"ok":false,"error":"internal_error"} — server-side failure, charge-then-error.
Registry inputSchema is null and no query-param documentation exists; the bare GET that is advertised as payable does not actually produce data.
Payment accepted on both Solana and Base (eip155:8453); qa-pay settled on Base. Failure is not network-specific (server-side 500).
usage.guide: Do not use this endpoint as-is: GET https://x402.dexter.cash/onchain/activity accepts the x402 payment ($0.05 USDC, Base or Solana) but then returns HTTP 500 {ok:false,error:"internal_error"} with no usable data. The registry exposes no input schema or query parameters, so there is nothing to adjust to make it work. Treat as broken/dead until the provider fixes the server; calling it only loses money.
